query_date_policy: query_date records the human evidence structuring date; travel_date records the 12306 ticket date shown in screenshots.
fare_selection_rule: For each route, inspect the visible G/C/D intercity or high-speed train candidates in the 12306 screenshot; exclude trains without an explicit second-class or second-class-cabin fare; select the candidate with the shortest visible travel duration; if durations tie, select the lower second-class fare; if both tie, select the earlier departure time. Do not use business class, first class, sleeper, no-seat, flight, promotion, guessed, or refreshed online fares.
